feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: Abdul El-Sayed welcomes Trump's plan to cut Israel aid, calls for end to arms sales
entry.summary: Michigan's first Muslim senator-elect, Abdul El-Sayed, discusses his historic victory, an unlikely agreement with Trump on Israel military aid and the political divisions that remain.

entry.title: The world is reacting to the Democrats' sweeping midterm elections victory
entry.summary: From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats' big win as foreign powers weigh how a flipped Congress will affect international relations.

entry.title: Democrats seize full control of Congress. And, which candidates made history last night
entry.summary: Democrats have won the House and the Senate, taking full control of Congress for the first time since 2023. And history was made in several states. Here's what happened last night.

entry.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
entry.summary: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.

entry.title: For Ukraine's Kherson region, a short ceasefire meant a momentary return to normal life
entry.summary: In Kherson city, usually seething with Russian drones, friends met at cafes, families were out together and shoppers stocked up. "The city seems alive," said one resident, "just like it used to be."

entry.title: Indian navy rescues 20 crew from Iranian fishing boat hijacked off Somalia
entry.summary: he operation involved a warship, a maritime surveillance aircraft and marine commandos. The hijacking followed a resurgence of Somali piracy across the Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean.

entry.title: Control of Congress is at stake today. And, judge to consider motion in Clancy case
entry.summary: Election Day is here, and voters are heading to the polls in an election that may change control of Congress. And, a judge is considering whether to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case.

entry.title: Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing
entry.summary: Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles across nine regions, President Zelenskyy said in an online post that noted the barrage coincided with U.S. elections.

entry.title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
entry.summary: Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.

entry.title: Hundreds evacuate city during temporary ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine
entry.summary: The ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city has ended. The ceasefire, which lasted several days, allowed hundreds of residents to evacuate.
